==About==

A {{i|Silt-Dwelling Mudsnapper}} can be dried on a {{i|Drying Frame}} for 72 hours to make a {{i|Dried Silt-Dwelling Mudsnapper}}. Due to the current nature of the most recent Fish rework there is no reason to ever make a Dried Silt-Dwelling Mudsnapper.
